title: Healthcare ML pipeline
alt: Tactile miniature clinical folders and records connect to an HPC cluster and model chip, then to a risk-evaluation workstation and output records.

title: Wireless-edge LLM inference
alt: A miniature laptop runs the model prefix, linked over wireless communication to an edge server running the remaining model. A central resource-control dial connects to both hosts; a separate cable returns the response.

title: Resource-aware federated learning
alt: Three miniature client laptops retain private data and prefix layers. Blue and sage cables connect them to a central server with per-client model tails, a shared compute pool, and an allocation dial.

title: Mathematical formula recognition
alt: A document and magnifying lens represent formula localization. A recognition workstation, symbol tiles, and a spatial puzzle represent symbol and structure recognition; a connected laptop shows editable LaTeX output.

title: Procurement automation
alt: An internal-user workstation connects to an application server surrounded by quotation, invoicing, and supplier-record objects. Separate cables link the application to a SQL storage canister.

title: CRS-Triage
alt: Structured clinical records and text notes connect through separate model chips to a central fusion assembly and a reliability dial. Branching outputs reach an acuity card or a review clipboard, representing prediction or deferral.

title: Vehicular LLM diagnosis
alt: A miniature vehicle with on-board intelligence connects through a wireless-network and satellite concept to cloud diagnosis services. A knowledge store, history notebook, and expert-review clipboard support retrieval and curated feedback.

title: Secure split-learning admission
alt: A client laptop sends requests to a physical admission gate with a risk-ranking chip and timed proof-of-work token. Rejected requests enter a side tray; admitted requests reach a protected training server. Offline training materials supply the ranker.
